a261007p1.summary: Some of the AI industry's fastest-growing startups are becoming serial acquirers, buying smaller companies to fill product gaps …
a261007p1.title: AI startup acquisitions by other AI startups hit 195 through Sept. 29, up 14% from all of 2025, but number of buyers grew just 2%; OpenAI was the most active (Mary Ann Azevedo/Crunchbase News)

a261007p10.summary: This is fine.png — A game of cat-and-mouse between Sony and hackers is very much underway, as the PS5 has been jailbroken to a massive degree in the past week.
a261007p10.title: PS5 modders using AI tools have rapidly installed emulators, as jailbreaks spread across social media; recent games requiring newer firmware are inaccessible (Sammy Barker/Push Square)

a261007p11.summary: Elon Musk said his business empire will build and operate Terafab independently, quashing speculation about industry leader …
a261007p11.title: Elon Musk says his business empire will build and operate the Texas-based Terafab chipmaking project, quashing speculation about TSMC having an operational role (Debby Wu/Bloomberg)

a261007p12.summary: A Taiwan union representing workers at Micron Technology (MU.O) said on Wednesday it had secured authorisation from its members …
a261007p12.title: A Taiwan union representing Micron workers says it has secured member authorization to strike over the company's bonus scheme; the details are under discussion (Wen-Yee Lee/Reuters)

a261007p13.summary: Winning bets on hot AI startups are propelling a little-known Dallas firm into a small group of firms raising gigantic funds
a261007p13.title: Sources: Dallas-based Disruptive is targeting up to $10B for a late-stage fund, and has secured $7.5B; founded in 2012, it has backed Groq and Reflection AI (Kate Clark/Wall Street Journal)

a261007p14.summary: The glasses are now available for pre-order. — Xreal has officially launched its Android XR-powered Aura smartglasses …
a261007p14.title: Xreal opens preorders for its Android XR-powered Aura glasses with a compute puck, starting at $1,279 for 12GB/256GB, in the US, Canada, Japan, and South Korea (Mariella Moon/Engadget)

a261007p15.summary: Google Playground is a browser-based tool for making games from AI prompts. … Google today announced Playground …
a261007p15.title: Google launches Playground, a browser-based, no-code AI game creation platform available to US users aged 18+, powered by Gemini, Nano Banana, and Lyria (Jay Peters/The Verge)

a261007p16.summary: Xreal's long-hyped Aura glasses arrive soon for $1,279. Here's how they fare against Meta's recently announced VR Glasses.
a261007p16.title: Xreal's Aura and Meta's VR Glasses hands-on: both have a compute puck and are light, but Aura's arrive in 2026 and have passthrough lenses suitable for walking (Boone Ashworth/Wired)

a261007p17.summary: Artificial intelligence companies that can help even bigger companies to get paid are likely to make a fair bit of money themselves …
a261007p17.title: Stuut, which uses AI agents to automate enterprise order-to-cash cycles and serves 150+ clients, raised a $52.5M Series B led by Insight, for $93M total funding (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)

a261007p2.summary: European Commission considers a broad levy on all large companies to avoid singling out US digital services groups
a261007p2.title: Sources: the European Commission considers taxing big US tech companies through a broad levy on large corporations to avoid singling out individual companies (Financial Times)

a261007p3.summary: Shenzhen Transsion Holdings Co., which dominates the market for smartphones in Africa, is seeking to raise as much as HK$3.36 billion …
a261007p3.title: Filing: China-based Transsion, which commands 53% of Africa's mobile phone market by unit sales, is seeking to raise as much as ~$428M in a Hong Kong share sale (Sangmi Cha/Bloomberg)

a261007p4.summary: City-state averse to risk and scandal tries to distance itself from homegrown Hyperliquid Labs and its popular ‘perps’
a261007p4.title: Sources: Singapore distances itself from regulating Hyperliquid, citing its "decentralized nature", even as the crypto futures DEX confirms it is based there (Owen Walker/Financial Times)

a261007p5.summary: The data center build-out is exploding across America. But what if AI didn't need more—more chips, more energy, more resources …
a261007p5.title: Turba Labs, which develops tech for optimizing AI infrastructure by creating digital twins of data centers, emerges from stealth with a $52M seed and Series A (Sarah Klearman/Wall Street Journal)

a261007p6.summary: Asia's market leaders Grab and GoTo face squeezed margins over push to offer better deal to workers
a261007p6.title: GoTo and Grab face pressure to offer drivers better deals; GoTo's share price has fallen 90% from its 2022 peak, while Grab's has fallen 50% in the past year (Financial Times)

a261007p7.summary: Spotify announced on Wednesday that it's expanding audiobook access to over 180 markets worldwide, including regions across Europe …
a261007p7.title: Spotify expands audiobooks to 180+ markets, bringing its catalog to 750M+ users, and adds 350K+ titles in 120+ languages in partnership with 300+ publishers (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)

a261007p8.summary: ChatGPT's teen-focused experience 'doesn't send alerts to parents when it should,' according to an assessment.﻿
a261007p8.title: Common Sense Media calls ChatGPT for Teens an "unacceptable risk", saying its guardrails fall short of OpenAI's promises and it continues to do kids' homework (Jay Peters/The Verge)

a261007p9.summary: Google has been ordered to halt work on two data centers it's developing in Finland, a month after the tech giant committed …
a261007p9.title: Finland orders Google subsidiary Tuike Finland Oy to halt data center construction in Muhos and Kajaani by October 23, pending environmental impact assessments (Kai Nicol-Schwarz/CNBC)
